title: The whole suite's darwin wall time is bounded by two module scopes, test_land_e2e.py and test_backlog_portable.py, each 22 to 29 s of serial tests on one worker
goal: tests.py hands the suite's tests to its workers one at a time (pytest-xdist --dist load in run_pytest, conftest's SLOW_FIRST order kept so the long scenarios start first), so no module or class scope bounds a full run's wall time; a full tests.py run on a quiet darwin host takes at most 27 s (python3 _tools/perfcheck.py time --max-seconds 27 exits 0) with no test id lost; kb/_self/code.md's Git in tests section and the other docs that name the distribution mode say the new one

run: import subprocess,sys;t=subprocess.run([sys.executable,'_tools/selfdoc.py','section','code','Git in tests'],capture_output=True,text=True).stdout;sys.exit(1 if 'loadscope' in t or 'Git in tests' not in t else 0)

clauses.clause: tests.py hands the suite's tests to its workers one at a time (pytest-xdist --dist load in run_pytest, conftest's SLOW_FIRST order kept so the long scenarios start first), so no module or class scope bounds a full run's wall time

notes: Merged at the 2026-10-14 test-suite overhaul plan: BG-qnbcyw72 (full run 30 to 37 s against 29 s on darwin through SP-ia6xayiy, SP-hlt2tdel and the workers of 2026-10-14, 112 passing: the same symptom, whose cause this item names and removes), BG-nnpssuqa and ST-nhax64i4 (host findings of SP-waxgh3kg and SP-b7wibqok asking the operator for headroom: the operator decided on 2026-10-14 that the limits stay, D-ilojyzhk, and the suite is made faster instead). Measured on 2026-10-14 on a quiet darwin host, 12 workers, 112 ids: loadscope 31.1 s pytest (33.1 s tests.py), the module scope of test_land_e2e.py's five plain functions 30.2 s serial on one worker and test_backlog_portable.py's 17 functions 27.0 s; --dist load 24.4, 24.7, 24.9 and 23.7 s (one run at 28.0 s during the planner's own back-to-back runs, load average 6), --dist worksteal 25.1 s; worker count is no lever (load at 14 workers 25.5 s, at 8 27.7 s); ordering the tests by measured duration, longest first, was slower (27.7 s). The suite has no order dependence: load and reordered runs passed 112 of 112. test_prepush_e2e.py's module fixture is built per worker under load (2.6 s setup), included in the figures.
